style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of heavy, cream-colored financial documents and embossed vesting certificates arranged on a dark leather desk blotter. The papers are fanned out to reveal exactly six distinct staggered layers or tranches. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight with a single warm focused desk lamp casting soft directional shadows across the textured paper stock. negative_prompt: text, lettering, numbers, typography, watermarks, logos, signatures, UI, human hands, messy, chaotic
rationale: The story revolves entirely around equity contracts, vesting schedules, and tax-year planning. A document flatlay elegantly captures the administrative tension of staggered financial decisions without relying on literal aerospace tropes.
subject: a staggered arrangement of embossed vesting schedules and financial documents divided into six distinct layers
core_thesis: A staged IPO lockup forces employees to navigate six separate trading windows instead of one, complicating tax liability and wealth management.
core_conflict: Staggered equity release schedules vs. standard corporate trading rules and rigid tax year deadlines.
alt_text: Six staggered financial documents fanned out on a dark leather desk blotter under soft directional lighting.
caption: Staggered equity releases force workers to manage multiple trading windows across different tax years.
